lines.1: Whew. I had worked all morning.
lines.2: 「You washed your hands thoroughly with soap, yes?」
lines.6: 「You really love rice balls, don't you?」
lines.8: She said it with a radiant smile.
lines.9: 「They go into a separate stomach entirely. I can eat any number at any time.」
lines.10: ...Was she planning to serve these morning, noon, and night?
lines.13: I did not intend to make rice balls my staple food.
lines.14: A rotation for household chores really did seem best.
lines.16: 「This one has wasabi. If you want meat, take the one wrapped in nori. I put some karaage inside.」
lines.19: 「Which flavor do you like best, Otome?」
lines.20: 「I am often asked that, but it is a difficult question.」
lines.22: 「Making me choose just one of something so delicious is simply cruel...」
lines.23: 「You don't have to take it that seriously.」
